verifies.G057-C1: the standard repository window action ('Create Spring Data repository with options…') is offered on an @EntityView interface when Blaze-Persistence's Spring Data integration is declared in the build (pom-blaze swapped in by setup) and creates the repository for the view through it. The window has no entity/view selector: the view is chosen by invoking the action in its source, and the parent interface is fixed to EntityViewRepository rather than selectable.

action.title: Create Spring Data repository with options…

note: Entity view through the standard action.
